title: Fruitbae Salt E-Liquid – Pomegranate Orange 30ml
description:
Description
Delectable Blood Orange meets sweet pomegranate juice. A fresh citrus inhale with a delightful pomegranate finish with a light cooling sensation. This savory blend of sweet and tart, with a zesty splash of citrus will guarantee to be quite a treat! Thirst quenching and delectable down to the last drop.
Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
55% VG 45% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Sorbae is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
